wiki.summary: ICEMAN Episode 4 wraps up a series of cinematic YouTube livestreams Drake put out right before dropping his ICEMAN album at midnight. The whole thing plays like a moody short film and visual album. It gives a theatrical look into his life over the last two years, focusing heavily on themes of betrayal, feeling isolated, and finally moving past all the massive rap beefs from 2024. Read more on Last.fm.
